# Welcome {background-color="#275882"}

## Welcome to PS50008A! {.center}

**Research Methods & Experimental Design**

Your first session of the module

---

## Today: The Data Olympics

::: {.objectives-box}
**Today You Will:**

- Rotate through 6 stations in pairs
- Complete cognitive tasks
- Record your data in Qualtrics
- Form your project groups
:::

---

## Why "Data Olympics"?

The data you generate today becomes our teaching dataset for the term.

When we learn about:

- Distributions → [your reaction times]{.hl-yellow}
- t-tests → [Room A vs Room B]{.hl-blue}
- Correlations → [your variables]{.hl-green}

...we'll use **your** data.

---

# The Stations {background-color="#275882"}

## Six Stations

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.step-1}
**1. Simple Reaction Time**

How fast can you respond?
:::

::: {.step-2}
**2. Choice Reaction Time**

Does decision-making slow you down?
:::

::: {.step-3}
**3. Memory Task**

How many items can you recall?
:::
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.step-1}
**4. Estimation Task**

How accurate are your judgments?
:::

::: {.step-2}
**5. Group Estimation**

Does discussion improve accuracy?
:::

::: {.step-3}
**6. Confidence Ratings**

How well do you know what you know?
:::
:::

::::

---

# How It Works {background-color="#275882"}

## The Process

::: {.incremental}
1. Find a partner
2. Go to your assigned starting station
3. Complete the task (one tests, one participates)
4. Record data in Qualtrics
5. Swap roles
6. Move to next station when signalled
:::

---

## Recording Your Data

::: {.callout-important}
## This is Real Research!
Record data carefully—your data will be used throughout the term.
:::

- Use the Qualtrics link on your phone/laptop
- Enter your participant ID (we'll assign these)
- Follow the instructions at each station

# Project Groups {background-color="#275882"}

## Form Your Groups

By the end of today, form groups of [**3-4 students**]{.inverse-box}.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Consider:
- Can you meet outside class?
- Will you be reliable partners?
- You'll work together all term
:::

---

## What Groups Do

Your group will:

- Work together on the **group research project**
- Conduct labs together from **Week 16**
- Generate data for the **Research Report** (Week 22)
